Name: Treasure Room Chance
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Tired checking fortune teller every day, saving magic rock candy and crafts staircases, only to still miss out the auto-petter or any other items you wanted and ended up completely disappointed? This mod lets you configure the chance for treasure room to spawn in skull cavern, along with the items you wanted. Note that treasure room only appear above floor 10 of skull cavern.

Check out my QoL mods on
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]

Downloads.Description: Configure chance for treasure room to appear in skull cavern, and the loot to obtain.
